variants.headline: Assembly votes down government bill
variants.body: A government bill has been voted down in the Colonial Assembly. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.

variants.headline: A proposal meets its parliamentary limit
variants.body: The Assembly has rejected a bill put forward by the government. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.

variants.headline: Government legislation fails the vote
variants.body: A proposed government bill has failed in the Assembly vote. Labour finds the stewardship of {target} wanting; ordinary people deserve a more responsible standard of conduct.
